name: MR BIG
source:
They've known each other for years, over the internet, but Carter and Hartland's first ever meeting in real life ended in gut-wrenching disaster.

Now Hartland has traveled halfway across the country to spend the last remnants of the 20th century with the man he loves.

But the man he loves has undergone a surprising change. He's confident, upbeat, flirtatious-

- and suddenly, out of nowhere, he's hung.

With a unique, off-putting art style, charming characters, and a strange mystery to uncover, I hope you'll enjoy your time with Mr Big.

[From [url=https://kingoliard.itch.io/mr-big]Itch.io[/url]]
